product.title: Downtown Houston Brewery Bike Tour

description.text: Cycle a flat downtown Houston and East End route between local breweries with a guide on a small-group bike tour. Gear and beer samples are included as you roll past murals and neighborhood streets between tasting stops. Stops include Local Group Brewing, Downtown Houston, East End Murals, Brewery Stops. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
